item.title: 2Face’s family petitions IGP, accuses Natasha of assault, financial misappropriation, bigamy
item.description: Singer, 2Face Idibia’s family has petitioned the Inspector General of Police, IGP, against his wife, Natasha Osawuru. The family in the petition that surfaced online on Thursday, accused Natasha of financial misappropriation, assault, bigamy, alleged threat to life, and substance abuse. item.title: Gunmen kidnap APC chieftain in Ibadan
item.description: Gunmen, on Wednesday evening, abducted a prominent chieftain of the All Progressives Congress, APC, Wale Oriade, in Ibadan. item.title: Abia, Imo launch joint security task force, surveillance against bandits
item.description: The governments of Abia and Imo States have announced the launching of a joint security taskforce and surveillance along the Aba-Owerri expressway, starting from Owerrinta in Abia State all the way to Owerri, Imo State. The launch followed recent attacks by criminals on the expressway, including kidnapping, armed robbery and other criminal activities. item.title: Nigerian govt engages EFCC, ICPC to verify ongoing, completed federal road projects
item.description: Minister of Works, David Umahi, has disclosed that the Federal Government has invited the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission, EFCC, and the Independent Corrupt Practices Commission, ICPC, to audit and verify all ongoing and completed federal road projects across the country. item.title: UN experts demand Tanzania killings probe as EU, US press Hassan
item.description: United Nations human rights experts, on Thursday, in Geneva denounced the widespread and systematic infringement of rights in Tanzania after the controversial October 29 general elections. The Special Rapporteurs and the Working Group on Enforced or Involuntary Disappearances decried the extrajudicial killings, disappearances, and mass detentions targeting protesters, opposition figures, and civil society.
